title: Answer: consciousness is a network of integrated experience, by premise

statements.text: Consciousness is a network of integrated experience. Every vibe experiences, its tone of pain, peace or pleasure being how it feels, and consciousness is what those experiences are when they hang together as one network. Vibe explores whether integration, how much a region loses when it is cut, is the measure of that hanging together, read from the tones and links of the region at one beat. That a tone is felt is the premise, assumed and not derived, and every ledger row for selves and integration is partial.
statements.scope: the premise is assumed. Integration is measured mostly on older rules, a known attractor model or the mesh graph alone
